newsitem.title: USA: Paxar, Intl Imaging ink merger deal.
newsitem.headline: Paxar, Intl Imaging ink merger deal.

text.p: PAXAR Corp said it is buying International Imaging Materials for approximately $200 million in stock, or $24 a share and expected the deal to close in the fourth calendar quarter.

International Imaging shareholders are expected to recieve between 1.2 and 1.412 shares of PAXAR common stock in exchange for each share of International Imaging, the companies said in a joint statement. The companies said they expect the merger to be treated as a tax-free exchange of shares.

The exchange ratio will be determined prior to closing based upon PAXAR's average price per share measured during a pricing period. The transaction expects to be treated as a tax-free exchange to holders of International Imaging stock and will be accounted for as a pooling of interests transaction, the companies said.
